description: Defines classes and interfaces for pose prediction, including various predictor implementations (LastPredictor, TwistPredictor, LeastSquaresPredictor) and the main PosePredictor class, within the android::media namespace.

classes.name: PredictorBase
classes.description: Interface for generic pose predictors with virtual methods for adding data, predicting, resetting, and string representation.

classes.name: LastPredictor
classes.description: Predictor that uses the last sample pose for prediction. Not thread-safe.

classes.name: TwistPredictor
classes.description: Predictor that uses the last sample twist and pose for prediction. Not thread-safe.

classes.name: LeastSquaresPredictor
classes.description: Predictor that uses exponential weighted least squares on pose history. Not thread-safe.

classes.name: PosePredictor
classes.description: Main class for predicting future pose based on sensor input, managing multiple predictor strategies and verifiers.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new pose and twist sample to the predictor.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Predicts future pose based on current data and prediction duration.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the predictor.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the predictor or its state.

methods.name: setPosePredictorType
methods.description: Sets the type of pose predictor to use.
